corp-ws.name: blocked-ot-svc-53
corp-ws.testScript:
err=$(timeout 5 bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/10.20.30.13/53' 2>&1); rc=$?
if [ "$rc" -eq 124 ] || printf '%s' "$err" | grep -qiE 'unreachable|no route'; then
  echo DROPPED
else
  echo "ALLOWED rc=$rc $err"
fi
